programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Big Times For The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her…

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A map indicating the location of the Chan's family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan's daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and they have to team up to defeat them before unveiling the hidden secrets.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin…

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master “Shadow Whip”, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to “Shadow Whip”?

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family…

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: This is adapted from Louis Cha's “The Book and the Sword”. A young swordsman is tasked to lead a patriotic secret society to fight the traitorous general who colludes with the enemy. At the same time, he encounters a female warrior and two beautiful princesses, and is caught between all their affections for him.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Knight Of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Na Cha The Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Blooms of Happiness
programme.desc: Store owner Gao faces imminent divorce, yet he and his wife feign harmony to spare their parents. On a Chinese New Year family getaway, his mother uncovers his secret and suffers a serious car accident. Enter mysterious Mr. Fox, who offers to send Gao back in time to avert tragedy and save his marriage while upholding the universe's balance.

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Adapted from a famous Hong Kong comic, Tiger Wong is ambushed after he unwittingly took the Lousha Plaque but is saved by his brother Dragon Wong. They also befriended Turbo Shek during the fight and the trio forms a brotherhood. To avenge the death of the Dragon Gate masters, they train and vow to defeat Shibumi, the leader of Lousha Clan.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen
programme.desc: Set in the 1980s Hong Kong, Elaine and her best friend Ying enter the entertainment industry hoping to change their fates from poverty. Ying soon becomes a popular porn star but Elaine is lost between being her true self and an actress. When show business declines after a decade, their choices lead them to two different paths in life.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: Eight years ago, the family in a Hakka-walled village was torn apart during a combative winter solstice dinner. Eight years later, their cousin returns home from England and seeks to reunite the family for another winter solstice dinner. While things seem to be falling apart, this dinner may well be an opportunity to mend relations.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack, but luckily cyber security engineer Chun, manages to fend it off with his protective firewall system. To Chun's surprise, his boss is the mastermind of the attack, and when Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: P Storm
programme.desc: Ping reports a case of a rich man's son bribing prison guards to cover up his criminal activities in the prison to the ICAC. ICAC Chief Officer Luk goes undercover in prison to conduct his investigation. Despite the risks involved, Luk is determined to complete his mission with the help of his cell mate, Wang.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: The story is based on the Chinese legend "Journey to the West," which finds the playful, once-divine Monkey King (Stephen Chow), who is now reborn in a human form, employing a mysterious time-travel device (the titular box) in his quest to shed his human feet of clay. A showcase for the comic gifts of the rubber-faced and nimble Chow, with plenty of dramatic interest, special effects, and martial arts action.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse “Red Hare” to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, “Red Hare” may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: In this comedy, three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists they have dinner at home every night as a family, but tensions begin to rise when their girlfriends join in as well. Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wife's betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earth's surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earth's surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: Marriage With A Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and her boyfriend of seven years, Sean, are to be married in a week but both cheated on each other three days before the wedding. Faced with each of their perfect 'partners', Kiki and Sean ignore their responsibilities to each other and choose to go their separate ways…

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of brutal murders committed by a serial killer. Veteran detective Cham and rookie cop Will are assigned to the case. During the investigation, they encounter Wang Tao, who accidentally killed Cham's wife. Seeking redemption, Wang assists them in tracking down the killer, but her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: To Live and Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: Fai (Nick Cheung), a legendary triad figure, was convicted and sent to prison for slaughtering a bunch of people. 30 years later, with the help of a social worker (Chan Lai Wan), Fai release from prison, the city of Mongkok has totally changed and he has almost forgotten his way back home. Disoriented and trapped in the notorious town of vices, Fai must find his way out of a life with a mother suffering from Alzheimer's disease (Paw Hee Ching), a hooker girlfriend (Mo Xiaoqi) with her mentally-challenged younger sister (Natalie Meng), and a malicious cop (Liu Kai Chi) hot on his tail.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: Archaeologist Professor Fang uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream. To unveil the truth, Professor Fang leads his team to a journey into the glacier, embarking on a fantastical adventure together.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: Mobster Sing aspires to join the Axe Gang. As he stumbles into a slum ruled by eccentric landlords that are kung fu masters in disguise, his actions cause the gang and the landlords to engage in an explosive kung fu battle…

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Cinderella will change his life forever. Destiny means for him to fall in love with her but yet deny it. He is also to witness and relive the scene of the Monkey King (Stephen Chow)being subdued by the Goddess Of Happiness. The Joker is to become the Monkey King again but he will be unwilling to follow Monkey King's footsteps...

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Vital Signs
programme.desc: Paramedic Wang partners with Ma after being reassigned to a new station. Initially, Wang disagrees with Ma's unconventional methods, but over time, Ma helps him rediscover the true mission of a paramedic - saving every life.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: The story is based on a 1993 true event, the "China-Russia Train Robbery" where a gang of criminals commits a heist, stealing cash and goods from the cross border train. A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman heads the operation to arrest the criminals, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead…

Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

Setelah bertahun-tahun dan usianya yang menghampiri kematian, pak Harun mula sedar dan cuba membuang hantu raya tersebut yang mula menganggu penduduk kampung. Apatah lagi anak gadisnya putus tunang akibat dia membela hantu raya tersebut. Pak Harun akhirnya berjaya membuang hantu raya tersebut dengan bantuan seorang ustaz. Pak harun akhirnya meninggal dunia, anak dan isterinya berpindah selepas kematian pak harun

programme.desc: Sebuah rumah di tengah dusun tak dapat di robohkan sehingga di beli oleh faizal dan Yana. Faizal dan yana telah kehilangan anak perempuan mereka akibat kemalangan. Di dusun Yana bertemu Rinah iblis yang mendiami rumah tersebut. Rinah bagitahu Yana kalau dia boleh kembalikan anak yana yang mati. Yana lakukan ritual dan Naily benar-benar kembali. Menurut cerita rumah itu kepunyaan Rinah seorang bidan yang banyak membantu gugurkan kandungan dan suaminya Hamdi seorang bomoh. Keduanya mati di dalam rumah di bunuh penduduk kampung.

programme.desc: Kisah seorang penulis gosip terkenal yang bertemu lelaki berprinsip agama, lalu pertemuan itu mengubah cara hidup, pemikiran dan makna cinta dalam hidupnya.

programme.title: Mukhsin
programme.desc: Filem ini menceritakan kisah cinta pertama seorang budak lelaki bernama Mukhsin dengan seorang gadis bernama Orked. Berlatar di kampung, mereka mengalami pengalaman manis dan penuh emosi dalam kehidupan seharian, persahabatan, serta hubungan keluarga. Filem ini mengangkat tema kepolosan, kasih sayang dan nostalgia zaman kanak-kanak.

programme.title: Gerabak Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Luna, usahawan berjaya yang ditipu tunangnya, Razi. Dia kecewa apabila perniagaan yang mereka usahakan rugi kerana Razi terbabit dengan skandal wang serta mempunyai perempuan simpanan. Sementara itu, Gie pula baru saja dibuang kerja. Walaupun masih mencari kerja, dia sangat tenang dan tetap ceria. Gie reda dengan situasi menimpanya.

With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. It's time to breed and they must find a burrow before the females arrive.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: New Zealand's West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries and the life that thrives within them.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: Spring on New Zealand's east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. They've returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives difficult for them. Only the strongest will survive to carry forward their legacy.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: New Zealand's isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand's Creepiest Crawlies.

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Koala
programme.desc: Despite being one of Australia's best-known marsupials, koalas live only in the east and southeast parts of the continent. Learn how their lives and behaviors vary in these different regions.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: In clans of spotted hyenas, larger females call the shots while smaller males live peripheral lives. Meet a family suffering through drought, a mother struggling to provide for her cubs, and an orphan at the bottom of the social pile.

programme.title: Into The Wild India
programme.desc: Hoolock Gibbons are specialists of the Jungle. Living in close knit families, youngsters spend years learning the skills to survive. Meet Samar as he forages for food, avoids predators, and masters the acrobatics required for a life in the trees.

programme.title: Into The Wild India
programme.desc: The grasslands of Northeast India are one of the most fertile habitats on earth. Hundreds of species of tall grass flourish here, allowing one of India's most iconic creatures to thrive… the Greater One-horned Rhino.

programme.title: Into The Wild India
programme.desc: The Ladakh plateau is a land of extremes, but the Tibetan wild ass is the king of this grassland. Follow one stallion as he shadows a herd of females for his chance to sire the next generation, but in doing so, he must battle those wanting his crown!

programme.title: Into The Wild India
programme.desc: In a land of heat and tropical storms, life on the plains of southern India is tough. But Bibi, a female sloth bear with two cubs, is up for the challenge of her life as she fights against drought, food scarcity, and predators around every corner.

programme.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist
programme.desc: Race the clock with biologists as they try to figure out why North American loons are suddenly in danger. Unlock the mysterious lives of these beloved birds, and ponder whether their cries will continue to be summer's soundtrack or go silent forever.

programme.title: Kingdom Of The Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It's a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Boss Shark
programme.desc: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

programme.desc: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State's landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas' unique habitats.

programme.desc: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest.

programme.desc: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange - from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur moms that go into battle with baby on board.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild
programme.desc: Buried beneath a seabed littered with trash, a community of strange and fascinating creatures thrives against all odds. In this mucky ecosystem, predators and prey run an evolutionary arms race developing unlikely techniques of attack and defense.

programme.title: Wild Crusades
programme.desc: The forests of Yala National Park are home to the enigmatic sloth bear. Shy by nature, this animal is seldom seen and rarely filmed. Join a team of wildlife filmmakers as they reveal this mysterious bear's life and behaviour as never seen before.

programme.title: Wild Crusades
programme.desc: There's a new arrival at the Elephant Transit Home: a sick elephant calf abandoned near a reserve, another victim in the battle for space between humans and elephants. Study the innovative efforts to end this conflict, led by Dr. Pruthu Fernando.

programme.title: Wild Crusades
programme.desc: Hidden in the jungles of Sri Lanka is the toque macaque. Endemic to the island, these feisty group-living monkeys are found nowhere else on earth. And they are at the heart of the longest primate research project ever undertaken. Dr Wolfgang Dittus is on a quest to understand their complex society.

programme.title: Coastal Africa
programme.desc: This is the story of the “Golden Forest”, the vast expanses of kelp that lines Africa's southwestern shore. Fed by an upwelling of nutrients from deep in the Atlantic, the kelp forest nurtures four distinct worlds.

programme.title: Coastal Africa
programme.desc: The population of African penguins in Southern Africa is on the decline, but the charismatic species has found a stronghold on two islands in Algoa Bay. This is the story of the penguins' daily struggle to raise families in an unforgiving and hostile environment.

programme.title: Secret Life Of The Koala
programme.desc: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict. As breeding season begins, follow two large males on a mission to mate.

programme.title: Land Of Primates
programme.desc: Off the coast of Tanzania, baby Kima lives with his family of red Colobus monkeys. But what happens when he loses his way? Discover how this little monkey learns to adapt to life in the jungle—and find out if he can reconnect with his family again.

programme.title: Macro Worlds
programme.desc: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cranes fly towards south, a lot of mammals like deer get a thick winter fur or hide away and sleep where it's warm. But what do insects do? And why are they all back in spring?

programme.title: Macro Worlds
programme.desc: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it - you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror genre this extraordinary nature documentary takes you on a journey following a well-known hero with six legs, red wings and seven black dots through a seemingly normal meadow - but full of monsters.

programme.title: Macro Worlds
programme.desc: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the world's animals are beetles. They have conquered almost every corner and every habitat on the planet and they have survived every global disaster. What is it that makes them so successful?

programme.desc: Disebabkan bapanya tidak mampu menguruskan perniagaan akibat sakit, Hasbi (Mahdy Reza) kini meneruskan perniagaan pelancongan milik ayahnya. Pada hari pertama sahaja, Hasbi bertemu Sofa (Djihan Ranti) yang berhasrat membatalkan perjalanan umrah ayahnya. Namun, apabila Sofa mengetahui bahawa ayah Hasbi memerlukan kos rawatan yang tinggi, dia menawarkan diri untuk membantu mencari jemaah. Hasbi pastinya gembira, namun adakah bantuan itu hadir dengan niat lain?

programme.title: Cinta Di Ujung Sajadah
programme.desc: Rindu dan Fauzan terpaksa berdepan dengan kenyataan pahit apabila penipuan masa lalu Rindu terbongkar. Fauzan yang marah mengusir Rindu keluar dari rumah, dan Rindu berjuang untuk mendapatkan hak penjagaan anak mereka, Ayu. Dalam penyesalan, Fauzan mula menyedari bahawa cintanya terhadap Rindu masih belum padam. Namun, segalanya menjadi rumit apabila Fauzan berkahwin dengan wanita lain bernama Alia. Di sisi lain, Rindu berkenalan dengan Hafiz yang benar-benar menyayanginya.

programme.title: Satu Cinta Dua Hati
programme.desc: Rumah tangga Salwa dan Fahri dikurniakan dua cahaya mata iaitu Nayla dan Arsya. programme.title: Ustazah Biker
programme.desc: Apabila Danny tahu Airra berjumpa lagi dengan Ziyad, Danny mengamuk. Kali ini dia benar-benar hilang pertimbangan. Dia pergi ke rumah Airra dan melempang Airra dengan kuat. Dia cuba memukul Airra lagi. Mujurlah Cik Tom yang berada di dalam rumah nampak. Cik Tom marah dan dia mengambil kayu dan memukul Danny dengan kuat. Cik Tom mula sedar yang Danny bukan pilihan yang baik untuk Airra. Sekalipun Danny meminta ampun di atas apa yang dilakukannya tehadap Airra, namun hati Cik Tom sudah terluka melihat perbuatan Danny kepada Airra.

programme.desc: Episod ini akan menerangkan surah al-Insyiqaaq. Ia berkaitan dengan beberapa ayat untuk menerangkan hal yang berhubungan dengan peristiwa tertentu atau memberikan jawapan tertentu dalam bahagian dari ilmu tafsir Qur'an.

programme.title: Jom Baca
programme.desc: Episod kali ini ustaz akan mengajar adik-adik membaca surah al-Nasr. Perkongsian yang santai dan pembukaan dimulakan dengan Q&A yang menjurus kepada permasalahan, kemusykilan harian yang dihadapi.Ustaz juga akan meminta adik-adik tersebut mengaji surah tersebut dan membetulkan bacaan mana yang salah. Ustaz juga akan mengupas kegunaan serta kebaikan surah tersebut dan akan ada soal jawab bersama adik-adik tersebut.

programme.title: Kisah Dalam Al Quran

programme.title: Ceritaku

Siti Khadijah yang peka dengan kesusahan mereka yang tidak bernasib baik ini akan mencari VIP dan usahawan untuk membantu meringankan beban insan-insan yang tidak berkemampuan ini.

programme.title: Mek Gyver

programme.title: Negeri Yang Hilang Di Sarawak

programme.title: #ustazmasak

programme.desc: Perkahwinan Sufian dan Seri menjadi tular, Seri gembira menempatkan gambarnya bersama Saif dan Putri di bingkai yang sebelum ini milik Orked. Puan Lela kecewa kerana tidak dibawa bersama, manakala Orked terpaku tetapi tenang, menyedari ini strategi Sufian untuk mengekalkan penjagaan anak. Seri meniru peranan Orked, menguruskan rumah dan anak-anak untuk media sosial, tetapi mendapat kritikan netizen kerana perbandingan dengan Orked. Sufian pula dibebani tuntutan nafkah dan harta sepencarian dari Orked, yang diurus dengan matang dan strategik, disokong Mikael. Saif kelihatan murung walaupun ada ibu baru. Orked menyusun strategi tersendiri, tampil dalam podcast menegaskan haknya sebagai ibu tunggal, menekankan anak-anak membesar tanpa tekanan memilih pihak, dan memperoleh sokongan netizen. Seri semakin tertekan apabila Sufian lebih fokus pada imej dan perhatian Orked, manakala jualan sambal Seri merosot

programme.desc: After leaving reformatory, Xin Xiong joins a gang to make a living and soon he becomes a leader of the gang. He takes protection fees from vendors and works hard to 'maintain the local order' in his way. He has thus developed a very good relationship with the law enforcement unit. Later, a teahouse owner Gui Zhu has fallen in love with Xin Xiong who loves Yue Gui. The triangle relationship is entangled with jealousy.

programme.title: Father's Wish
programme.desc: In a small fishing village, Shun-Rong works tirelessly to support his wife and four children. When drought destroys their harvest and debts pile up, he is forced to take on extra fishing and even sell his own blood just to keep the family afloat. Despite hardship, he continues to face life with optimism, teaching his children resilience and hope as each of them grows toward their own future.

programme.title: Maria Mariana 2
programme.desc: Maria dikejarkan ke hospital dan menemui cinta bersama doktor yang menyelamatkannya. Kemudiannya, dia ditugaskan untuk membanteras sindiket pengedaran dadah. Hubungan Maria dan Mariana kembali tegang apabila bekas kekasih Mariana muncul kembali. Cara hidup liar Mariana menyebabkan dia diperalatkan dan menimbulkan kekacauan dalam hidup mereka.

programme.title: Castello
programme.desc: Solo mula menjalankan kegiatan sebagai pengedar dadah untuk menjadikan kehidupan keluarganya lebih mewah. Tapi Solo tertangkap dan dia dipenjara selama 20 tahun. Di dalam penjara, dia dikenali sebagai Castello. Keluar dari penjara, Castello cuba mengesan semula isteri dan anaknya. Tapi dia kecewa bila mengetahui anak gadisnya Phim telah menjadi penagih dadah. Castello berusaha untuk menyelamatkan Phim yang tidak menyedari bahawa Castello adalah bapanya

programme.title: Ke Medan Jaya
programme.desc: Hisham tinggal bersama ibunya, Mak Jah. Bapanya yang bekerja sebagai anggota tentera telah meninggal dunia akibat serangan musuh semasa zaman darurat. Sejak kematian suaminya, Mak Jah bekerja sebagai pembantu rumah dengan seorang hartawan bernama Pak Samad. Pak Samad dan isterinya tidak pernah menganggap Mak Jah sebagai pembantu rumah, malah Hisham dianggap seperti anak mereka sendiri dan mendapat pendidikan yang sama dengan Haryati, anak hartawan tersebut. Apabila wujud kemesraan antara mereka berdua, ibu bapa Haryati merasa bimbang kerana Haryati telah ditunangkan dengan Shahril. Setelah mengetahui kisah sebenar, Hisham mengambil Keputusan untuk menyertai angkatan tentera walaupun ditentang oleh ibunya.

programme.title: Cinta Metropolitan
programme.desc: Haris, seorang jurugambar bertemu semula dengan adiknya yang terkenal sebagai seorang casanova, Irwan. Tidak begitu senang dengan perangai adiknya yang suka menggoda sesiapa sahaja termasuk kekasihnya sendiri, hubungan mereka renggang. Satu sindiket pemalsuan wang terbongkar menyebabkan Haris, Irwan, Monisa dan dua orang lagi diburu sindiket itu sehingga ke luar negara.

programme.title: SH3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang percintaan dan persaingan siapa yang terbaik antara pemain papan selaju ketika kemuncak musik Hip Hop dan sukan papan selaju di negara. Khairul, ingin menjadi pemain papan selaju yang terbaik tetapi menemui kesulitan kerana lawannya, Mario yang juga sama mahir. Ingin memenangi hati Nelly, Khairul ingin terus membuktikan kehandalannya. Pada masa yang sama, Mario dan Mawar berpakat bersama-sama untuk memastikan mereka mendapat Khairul dan Nelly untuk diri mereka sendiri. programme.title: Ke Medan Jaya
programme.desc: Hisham tinggal bersama ibunya, Mak Jah. Bapanya yang bekerja sebagai anggota tentera telah meninggal dunia akibat serangan musuh semasa zaman darurat. Sejak kematian suaminya, Mak Jah bekerja sebagai pembantu rumah dengan seorang hartawan bernama Pak Samad. Pak Samad dan isterinya tidak pernah menganggap Mak Jah sebagai pembantu rumah, malah Hisham dianggap seperti anak mereka sendiri dan mendapat pendidikan yang sama dengan Haryati, anak hartawan tersebut. Apabila wujud kemesraan antara mereka berdua, ibu bapa Haryati merasa bimbang kerana Haryati telah ditunangkan dengan Shahril. Setelah mengetahui kisah sebenar, Hisham mengambil Keputusan untuk menyertai angkatan tentera walaupun ditentang oleh ibunya.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Imperial Coroner, The (II)
programme.desc: The story of the aloof Prince An, Xiao Jinyu, and Chu Chu, the imperial-appointed female coroner, after their marriage! Their careers, relationships, and overall perspectives are all upgraded. Together with the youth team of the Three Judicial Offices, they uncover the truth and solve bizarre cases, working hand in hand to safeguard the peace of the Tang Dynasty.

programme.title: Pretty Dangerous & What's On Today
programme.desc: Some dope called Powder Gremlin is everywhere in the city. Undercover cop Poon Yik-fung (Mark Ma) has been mingling with wise guys and eventually brings narcotic chemist Kuen Sai-ho to justice, but the crook only receives a lenient sentence! Yik-fung asks his boss to consider extending the undercover operation with permission to recruit a contingent of undercover policewomen, and the aim is to investigate the mysterious mastermind behind Sai-ho's scheme. Yik-fung selects three pretty female decoys, each with their unique talents: Shum Kai-kei (Kelly Cheung), aka Female Sherlock Holmes; Kong Miu-chi (Jeannie Chan), aka Meticulous and Sharp-witted Martial Arts Expert; and Tung Siu-yue (Yuki Law), aka Ever-changing Walking Encyclopedia. They have to get close to philanthropic businessman Lau Biu (Eddie Kwan) and his wife Bonnie Ka (Maggie Shiu), and the only obstacle is their daughter Lau Po-yee (Yumi Chung). However, Yik-fung has some hidden agenda as he pushes the female decoys to carry out risky tasks.

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN (Lau Dan) built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI (Koni Lui), is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE (Andrea So), often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Shining Just for You
programme.desc: The fantasy period drama "Shining Just for You" tells the story of Ye Ling Shuang (played by Peng Xiaoran), a grassland girl who is considered a jinx by her tribe because she can foresee disasters. Only Princess Qi Hai Rui (played by Liu Mengrui) of Ye Bei treats her like a sister. Ye Bei, overestimating its strength, launches a war against the Chao Kingdom, suffering a crushing defeat and losing many soldiers. Ye Ling Shuang is taken prisoner and sent to a brothel, but she refuses to submit. Using her talent for astrology, she enters the Imperial Observatory and gradually wins the heart of the ruthless emperor Yu Xiu Ming (played by Feng Shaofeng). However, just as their friendship deepens, Ye Ling Shuang learns of Qi Hai Rui's death and breaks ties with Yu Xiu Ming. Determined to save Qi Hai Rui, Ye Ling Shuang reverses time and returns to the Ye Bei of the past. Can she change what has already happened? And what will become of her relationship with Yu Xiu Ming?

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: The Taste Of Us
programme.desc: Delicious food, bursting with color, aroma, and flavor, not only fills the stomach but also soothes the soul! Liangliang (Mason Fung), a freelancer who loves singing and food, is feeling lost after breaking up with his girlfriend Jessica (Carmen Ngai). To prove his financial independence, he rents out his vacant room. His tenant, Azhi (Zeno Koo ), is a cooking enthusiast who frequently unleashes his culinary skills, creating a variety of heartwarming dishes such as "Miso Clam Soup" and "Chicken and Avocado Mexican Rolls"... The two young men hit it off immediately, satisfying each other's hunger and filling each other's voids! What kind of interesting relationship will these two very different personalities build?

The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: Kwoks And What, The
programme.desc: Seasoned Chinese frog closure instructor Kwok-Law Mei-lan (Paw Hee Ching) has raised her children and grandchildren by herself. She discovers everybody's issues before her 70th birthday. Her eldest son Kwok Tak-kan's (Joe Ma) business has failed, and he is also divorcing his wife Tian Yu-fei (Natalie Tong). Her second daughter Kwok Tak-bo (Che Yuen Yuen) and her son Kwok King-hin (Fei Wu) are drifting apart, and her relationship with her boyfriend has also ended. Her youngest son Kwok Tak-ming (Mat Yeung) loses his job as Tak-kan has got him into trouble. While Mei-lan wants to help her children solve their problems, she also plans to team up with her favorite disciple Chong Zi-chang (Grace Wong) to pass down the craft. Meanwhile, Tak-kan and his siblings keep contradicting each other. And gangster Kwok Chung-shek (Eddie Kwan) abruptly shows up and claims he has 50% ownership of the Kwoks' property. Can Mei-lan's strict adherence to the Kwoks motto “Keep walking and there's a way out” unite family members in the confrontation against the enemy?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2021
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Legal Mavericks 2020
programme.desc: Blind barrister Man Sun-hop (Vincent Wong), aka Perception Man, has a superlative fourth sense. He teams up with female legal executive Chiu Ching-mui (Sisley Choi) and private investigator Kut Yat-ha (Owen Cheung) to seek justice for the underprivileged. They never hesitate to use tactics that involve “pushing the boundaries”. Barrister Shaw Mei-la (Kelly Cheung) earnestly approaches Sun-hop. They are then to fight it out in court. Also, Mei-la's pupil master Kan Siu-wang (Paul Chun) constantly back Mei-la up. While Sun-hop was serving his pupillage with his pupil master Siu-wang, a homicide case involving some missing corpse had caused Shifu and his disciple to become foes. Sun-hop presents new evidence and lodges an appeal for the defendant. He and Siu-wang again confront each other, causing successive rounds of conflict. Meanwhile, the emergence of Mei-la brings about subtle changes in the formidable Sun-hop, Ching-mui and Yat-ha's triangular relationship.

programme.title: Food Mister
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what fictional dishes in literature would taste like? The flavors of the food described by authors are left to the reader's interpretation; however, it's not entirely impossible to cook them in reality. The host invites celebrity chefs to find creative inspiration from TV series, video games, cartoons, and literary classics, discovering some of the featured dishes mentioned within them, and then, through the skillful hands of these master chefs, "recreating" these seemingly unreal dishes. Can these fantastical dishes actually be cooked? Or are they merely the creators' fantasies? The program immerses viewers in a culinary world where fantasy and reality intertwine!

programme.title: Big Big Home
programme.desc: New buildings are glamorous and stylish, saving you a lot of decorating hassles. Older homes, with a little thought, can also be given a fresh new look. Host Tan Kaiying travels throughout Taiwan, delving into prime urban locations and emerging towns with development potential, exploring impressive luxury villas and unique homes in "The Big Dreamer"! How do Hong Kong residents who have moved to Taiwan realize their dreams of homeownership and entrepreneurship? Several "dreamers" share their local property buying stories and lifestyle guides. Director Lai Fengqi, Taiwanese-American singer Rong Zhonghao, artist Yang Zili, music producer Chen Hongjia, and Liu Lixue, the "father of Chinese computers" from Canada, will also reveal their comfortable homes on the show.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, “Group friend” listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4
programme.desc: " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4" has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating "masked," igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants; Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new season's stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4."

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Profession Impossible
programme.desc: To showcase the talents of local fashion designers, TVB specially produced a fashion design competition reality show. Ten contestants advanced from the preliminary rounds to the semi-finals, each designing two pieces for their collaborating artists based on environmental and Chinese themes, competing for five spots in the finals. The final five faced a final test, creating two outfits each based on a unisex and evening gown theme, which they then paired with their artists to showcase their style on the Catwalk stage, where the champion, first runner-up, and second runner-up were determined! Hosts Nancy Wu and Benjamin Yuen, along with "star" judges Walter Ma, William So, Gigi Leung, Kathy Chow, Amanda S., and others, witnessed the journey of "The Tailoring Magician".

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.desc: In 2026, "Pok Oi Charity Show 2026" will be hosted by Sammy Leung, Mayanne Mak, Yuen Ho-chung, and Chan Yee-tak, along with star singers to raise funds for Pok Loi through song, enabling the organization to continue extending a helping hand to those in need and promoting the spirit of "Bok Loi." programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Christian's Choice
programme.desc: Hong Kong's culinary industry has been buffeted by the pandemic, economic downturn, and a surge in consumer spending in mainland China, putting its precious culinary culture at risk. Some restaurants remain steadfast, honing their craft day after day, adapting to changing circumstances. They're sharing these challenging times with their customers through exceptional culinary skills and delicious cuisine, a journey that brings growth to the community. Adhering to the principles of authentic, independently owned restaurants with a long history, host Christian Yang curates a selection of "Friends" restaurants, exploring the hidden, heartwarming stories behind these establishments, tasting their extraordinary signature dishes, and appreciating the fighting spirit of Hong Kong's culinary culture.

Liangliang (Mason Fung), a freelancer who loves singing and food, is feeling lost after breaking up with his girlfriend Jessica (Carmen Ngai). His tenant, Azhi (Zeno Koo ), is a cooking enthusiast who frequently unleashes his culinary skills, creating a variety of heartwarming dishes such as "Miso Clam Soup" and "Chicken and Avocado Mexican Rolls"... The two young men hit it off immediately, satisfying each other's hunger and filling each other's voids! What kind of interesting relationship will these two very different personalities build?

programme.title: Global Citizens
programme.desc: In the grand trend of globalization, everyone's lives are interconnected. This eight-episode program invites eight foreign residents of Hong Kong to share the cultural characteristics of their countries. They come from Chile, Ukraine, Japan, Pakistan, the United States, Switzerland, and other countries. Each episode is divided into two parts. The first part invites guests to introduce the cultural characteristics of their own countries and, through their daily lives, to understand the extent to which they have integrated into Hong Kong life. The second part, in a talk show format, features guests and two hosts sharing their views on various social issues, including how to become a global citizen, the choices of Generation Y, working women, breaking down stereotypes, and property buying culture.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4
programme.desc: " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4" has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating "masked," igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants; Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new season's stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4."

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special "Fact Check" segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins. Apart from his discovery of HAU-YEE's dubious death, the best friend of the late HAU-YEE, TONG BING-BING (Tavia Yeung) also has a feeling of suspicion, so the two decide to launch an investigation.

programme.title: King Of Snooker, The
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant. His purpose cannot be more obvious: he is waiting for someone to solve the game. KIU comes to know KAN TSZ HIM (Patrick Tang) by chance. Noticing his flair for the snooker, KIU decides to make an exception for HIM and teaches him all he knows about the game. Later, KAN manages to persuade her father into taking her in as well.

programme.title: Brick Slaves
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work. In order to continue to pay the mortgage, YIU-MING has no other choice but to accept the unreasonable condition imposed by KIN-CHING, however the two often have arguments due to their differences in lifestyles. Later on, YIU-MING unveils that there is quite a story behind KIN-CHING's personality that makes everyone keep a distance from her. Eventually, YIU-MING finds a new job with a property management company. Unknown to him, his arrival ruins LO PIT-TAT's (Mak Cheung Ching) hope of getting promoted, so PIT-TAT, a third-generation brick slave, for the sake of keeping his own job becomes completely incompatible with YIU-MING at work. Nevertheless, YIU-MING gains recognition from his boss, LI OI-WAH (Sheung Tin Ngor), who even urges him to specifically look after a trainee called CHUK PIK-KEI (Eliza Sam). Due to their work, YIU-MING and PIK-KEI get to observe the world around the brick slaves. PIK-KEI gradually falls in love with YIU-MING, yet YIU-MING knows very well whom he really loves. All of a sudden, KIN-CHING requests to end the tenancy......

programme.title: Unchained Medleyr
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life. And she only wants to track down her crush Kuk Hang-wan from yesteryear. Yat-chun agrees to help as he wants to assist Lau-fong in fulfilling her wish. While they get along, a human and a ghost support each other, and they gradually fall in love. However, someone finds out about Lau-fong's ghost. They are afraid of the truth behind her death being exposed, so they decide to cover up everything at all costs.

programme.title: Rosy Business
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI's (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife. KIU's first and second wives, YAN FUNG YEE (Tse Suet Sum) and PANG KIU (Sheung Tin Ngor, Kiki), always make things difficult for KEI. KEI, who is an extremely clever person who never wastes time on trivial things, turns every threat into an opportunity. This makes KIU appreciate her wisdom and persistence. He entrusts his business to her and tells her to find a suitable successor for him before he dies. Despite all the attacks in the family, KEI manages to keep the business in good shape. She has never forgotten KIU's last wish, too. By chance, she discovers that TSEUNG PIT CHING (Ng Cheuk Hai, Ron), KIU's second son, is not really a playboy but an upright person loved by everyone in the shop. She therefore guides and helps him in every possible way, but her efforts are met with CHAI KAU's (Lai Yiu Cheung) challenges. KAU seeks vengeance for being mistreated and wants a pay back from TSEUNG family. After rounds after rounds of battle wits and actual fights, KEI and KAU begin to appreciate each other. KAU even falls for KEI as time goes by…

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins. Apart from his discovery of HAU-YEE's dubious death, the best friend of the late HAU-YEE, TONG BING-BING (Tavia Yeung) also has a feeling of suspicion, so the two decide to launch an investigation.

programme.title: Silver Chamber Of Sorrows, The
programme.desc: “Sheung's Silver Chamber”, the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM's family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG's younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM's family. Fueled by hatred, CHING SAU-HANG (Ng Wing Mei), WAN's lover, marries HANG and ironically becomes WAN's sister-in-law. WAN falls out with HANG, and opts to live abroad and disconnects from his family. After leaving home for years, WAN does not return home until the occasion to celebrate his father's birthday. Tension between the two brothers comes to a head when HANG is reluctant to pay ransom to save the youngest son of WAN. WAN is determined to disconnect completely from his family ever since. Since WAN's return, SAU-HANG suffers from her husband's neglect and gets framed for causing the fourth concubine FEI FEI's (Wu Ting Yan) miscarriage. Hatred leads her to commit act that revenge. She seeks to subvert SHEUNG's family by luring KWAN. Intentionally, she unveils TSAU KUK (Yeung Sze Ki), the maid in the family, is HANG's illegitimate daughter. The dark age of a once-prominent family begins…

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long's two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei's (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love. The two sisters have found the right guys. Tsz-long and Hoi-kei never miss any job opportunity as they want to have their own love nest. The couple move into a 100-square-foot plus subdivided unit after getting married. They not only have to deal with daily inconveniences due to insufficient space but also need to handle emotional issues of their aging parents on both sides.

programme.title: Ultimate Addiction, The
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases. His brother-in-law CHOW SUN-YUNG (Ben Wong), one of the CCB inspectors, is determined to put him in jail, collaborating with superior HO SHEUNG-YEE (Sharon Chan) and subordinate CHI NGA (Kate Tsui) to gather evidence. SUN-YUNG thinks highly of CHI NGA and even regards her as his last apprentice, to his surprise, CHI NGA suddenly resigns and starts working for CHEUK YUK.

programme.title: Legend Of Master Chai, The
programme.desc: In Heaven, Chai (Leung Wing Chun) killed Huen (Ho Po Sang) over a pot of sweet lotus seed soup. He was expelled to earth to suffer, while at the same time, he had to help Huen and Nui, who were also sent down to earth, to regain their powers. Chai was punished to become the stupid and shabby son, of an earthly man. Huen, on the other hand, was his handsome and clever brother, who was loved by all. One day, Chai regained his magic power and started to challenge Huen. Their relationship worsened as they both fell in love with Nui (Leung Siu Bing)…

programme.title: Conquest, The
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered. More than history, The Conquest is a vivid portrayal of the prominent historical figures of 2,500 years ago. Although they do not seem to belong to the world of today, their endurance and courage in the face of adversity will never go out of date.
